title: 3dTfitter
description:
* At each voxel, assembles and solves a set of linear equations.
 ++ The matrix at each voxel may be the same or may be different.
 ++ This flexibility (for voxel-wise regressors) is one feature
    that makes 3dTfitter different from 3dDeconvolve.
 ++ Another distinguishing feature is that 3dTfitter allows for
    L2, L1, and L2+L1 (LASSO) regression solvers, and allows you
    to impose sign constraints on the solution parameters.

RHS.description: Specifies the right-hand-side 3D+time dataset. ('rset' can also be a 1D file with 1 column)
RHS.title: Right-Hand Side dataset

LHS.description: Specifies a column (or columns) of the left-hand-side matrix. More than one 'lset' can follow the '-LHS' option.
LHS.title: Left-Hand Side matrix

polort.description: Add 'p+1' Legendre polynomial columns to the LHS matrix.
polort.title: Polynomial Order

vthr.description: The value 'v' (between 0.0 and 0.09, inclusive) defines the threshold below which LHS vectors will be omitted from the regression analysis.
vthr.title: Vector Threshold

FALTUNG.description: Specifies a convolution (German: Faltung) model to be added to the LHS matrix. Followed by four arguments: 'fset', 'fpre', 'pen', 'fac'.
FALTUNG.title: Convolution (FALTUNG) Model

lsqfit.description: Solve equations via least squares [the default method].
lsqfit.title: Least Squares Fit

l1fit.description: Solve equations via least sum of absolute residuals.
l1fit.title: Least Sum of Absolute Errors

l2lasso.description: Solve equations via least squares with a LASSO (L1) penalty on the coefficients. Followed by 'lam' and optional 'i j k ...'
l2lasso.title: L2 LASSO Regression

lasso_centro_block.description: Defines a block of coefficients that will be penalized together.
lasso_centro_block.title: LASSO Centro Block

l2sqrtlasso.description: Similar to '-l2lasso', but aims to minimize sqrt(Q2)+lam*L1.
l2sqrtlasso.title: Square Root LASSO

consign.description: Indicates that the sign of some output LHS parameters should be constrained in the solution.
consign.title: Constrain Sign of Parameters

consFAL.description: Constrain the deconvolution time series from '-FALTUNG' to be positive if 'c' is '+' or to be negative if 'c' is '-'.
consFAL.title: Constrain FALTUNG

prefix.description: Prefix for the output dataset (LHS parameters) filename.
prefix.title: Prefix for Output

label.description: Specifies sub-brick labels in the output LHS parameter dataset.
label.title: Output Labels

fitts.description: Prefix filename for the output fitted time series dataset.
fitts.title: Fitted Time Series Output

errsum.description: Prefix filename for the error sums dataset.
errsum.title: Error Sums Output

mask.description: Read in dataset 'ms' to use as a mask; only voxels with nonzero values in the mask will be processed.
mask.title: Mask Dataset
